description:
Retrieve a single chat (without its messages). This method supports federation. To access a chat, at least one chat member must belong to the tenant the request initiated from.

TIP: Gets a specific Teams chat by ID, scoped to a user. Returns full details: chatType, topic, members snapshot (via $expand=members), lastMessagePreview, webUrl. Use $expand=members,lastMessagePreview to avoid round-trips. The chat-id is the canonical Teams thread identifier (19:xxx@thread.v2 format). Same caveat as list-user-chats — admin-level investigation only (Chat.Read.All in app mode is no longer metered since 2025-08-25).

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-chat
